title: SectionLab — CAD-grade interface
brief: Redesign the SectionLab desktop window so it reads as a professional cross-section tool with CAD icons and a CAD-feeling drawing area, replacing the current generic Qt form look.

artboards.title: Estación CAD oscura
artboards.tradeoff: Feels like professional CAD and keeps the eyes calm for long sessions; a dark canvas is harder to print or project and needs careful contrast tuning.

artboards.title: Plano técnico claro
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like an engineering sheet with a ribbon and a wide results strip that shows twelve values at once; the light surface is less comfortable at night and the ribbon costs vertical space.

artboards.title: Estudio compacto con comandos
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum drawing area with floating palettes and an AutoCAD-style command line for power users; floating panels overlap the drawing and the command line assumes users learn its vocabulary.
